messages:
Priya: FYI — MistralWorks renewal in ~6 weeks. Noticed a sustained drop in activity starting last Tue, daily requests down ~68%. Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.example.com/customers/mistralworks/usage :eyes:
Dylan: Thanks Priya. Do we know if this is a product issue or a stakeholder change? Any recent infra tickets?
Tom: Reached out to their champion (Ava) this morning. She said the new Platform lead (CTO hire) is re-evaluating AI stack and kicked off a vendor bakeoff. No formal decision yet.
Elena: Also saw a burst of errors from their integration last week — looks like an auth token rotation caused batch jobs to fail. Paste from their logs:
```
2024-06-15T08:12:03Z ERROR auth.go:92 token expired for service-account wf-sync
2024-06-15T08:12:04Z WARN retrying request, attempt=1
```
They restarted the consumer but didn’t re-enable scheduled jobs.
Priya: So two signals: stakeholder change + infra problem. If we fix the integration quickly we probably recover some baseline usage and buy time on the renewal. Can someone own the tech touch? @Tom?
Tom: I can take tech touch. Plan: 1) short debug call w/ their eng tomorrow 2) offer to run a 2-week cost/perf pilot on Dedicated to show savings vs competitor. Will ask for sample query trace and peak QPS.
Dylan: I'll own the commercial outreach. Will surface the pilot offer and confirm renewal timeline. Also want a one-pager comparing unit cost w/ two competitors — can we get that from Ops? @Priya can you ping ops-squad? :thumbsup:
Priya: Pinged ops-squad with logs + usage slices. Also creating a one-page playbook in the account doc.
renewal-bot: Reminder: MistralWorks contract renewal window opens in 42 days. SLA: standard.
Elena: Quick note — when we fix auth we should toggle the prefix cache off for 24h to avoid stale responses. Small config snippet to share on call: `REDWOOD_PREFIX_CACHE=false`
Tom: Scheduled eng deep-dive for tomorrow 11am PST. I'll post notes. Who should be on the call from CS?
Dylan: I'll join and lead the commercial ask. Priya you'll do the playbook + postmortem items?
Priya: Yep. I'll draft a prioritized win-back checklist: 1) fix batch auth 2) demo cost delta 3) two-week pilot proposal 4) exec sync with new CTO.
Tom: After call I'll send a short remediation checklist and ETA for job restart.
Dylan: If pilot gets greenlight, propose a short-term discount + performance SLA guarantee to counter competitor pitch.
Priya: Assigning owners: tech = Tom, commercial = Dylan, ops docs = Priya. Follow-up check-in Wed EOD.
Tom: :raised_hands:
Dylan: :eyes: thanks team.
Priya: Filing thread into account doc and tagging renewal-warn.
renewal-bot: Thread archived to account/MistralWorks/renewal-warn on 2024-06-18 16:00:00 UTC
